## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing while credit stress is rising (Credit Spread 1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.49%) ABOVE TREND — mixed confirmations support NEUTRAL.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear falling: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) BELOW TREND. Credit strain creeping: HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND, signaling divergent credit signals.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-supportive equities vs bonds: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND keeps duration underperforming. Dollar stable: Dollar Index proxy (1W: -0.11% | 1M: -0.78%) BELOW TREND and yield curve modestly flatter (1W: -0.20%) → neutral conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading hard: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND. Tech showing broad strength too: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND while Consumer Discretionary (XLY 1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) is in CORRECTION — style: Growth/Tech leadership with cyclical rotation into Energy.

5. US vs Global?  
US holding up: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND shows EM participation. China lagging: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) in CORRECTION and China tech metrics falling → region-specific weakness.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative risk intact: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ABOVE TREND. Crypto cooling: IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Metals strong: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial/energy metals mixed but CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) ABOVE TREND—commodity reflation theme present.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy proving dominant: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ABOVE TREND — clear momentum into the sector while UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) in RECOVERY shows nat-gas noise.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND on both horizons. Divergences: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION and LQD/TLT (LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86% BELOW TREND; TLT 1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18% BELOW TREND) highlight mixed credit/duration signals.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to Energy (XLE 1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) and select Tech (XLK 1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) given breadth; reduce exposure to China (FXI 1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) and crypto (IBIT 1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) amid divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) and XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) if momentum persists. BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) and XLP (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%) if discretionary/staples weakness deepens.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) and GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) on continued energy/inflation upside. BEARISH: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) if nat-gas demand softens.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (VXX 1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) as complacency threshold; HYG/LQD spread near 0.75 (HYG 1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37% ABOVE TREND; LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86% BELOW TREND) for credit health; XLK/XLF ratio ~3.27 (Tech vs Financials 1W: +1.37% | 1M: +4.68%) for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive.  
XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) and XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) showing relative strength.  
Key risk is rising credit strain vs easing fear—HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) in CORRECTION to monitor.
